summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including improvements to the Spark integration and the introduction of finer-grained read restrictions. Ongoing votes and discussions on the REST specification and metadata management reflect the community's focus on refining the framework and addressing technical challenges.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Vote on consistent wording for table identifier conflict in REST Spec
Proposal for finer-grained read restrictions in loadTable response
Discussion on offloading snapshot history from metadata.json
